read.thesis: Express parcel pricing held (US domestic yield +7%, Intl +17%) and CY26 EPS guide raised to $18.00–18.60, but Q4 faces ~$310M transitory cost headwinds and US domestic margin fell 20bp in Q3.

capex.quote: We continue to expect $3.9 billion of CapEx for CY '26, of which 90% is maintenance or efficiency related.

triggers.label: CapEx $3.9B held; aircraft ≤$1B
triggers.quote: We remain committed to our 4% CapEx-to-revenue target by the end of 2029, and for aircraft CapEx to remain at $1 billion or less annually.

triggers.label: US Domestic yield +7%
triggers.quote: U.S. Domestic package yield was up 7%, driven by mid- to high single-digit yield growth across all services.

triggers.label: CY26 EPS raised to $18.00–18.60
triggers.quote: we are raising and tightening our CY '26 outlook to $18 to $18.60.

triggers.label: Q4 PT rate headwind $130M
triggers.quote: $130 million tied to higher over-the-road line-haul rates, which shows up in purchased transportation

triggers.label: Ground economy volume -4%
triggers.quote: Consistent with our strategy to focus on differentiated premium services, ground economy volume declined 4%.

guidance.quote: we are raising and tightening our CY '26 outlook to $18 to $18.60.
we expect to generate approximately $4 billion in adjusted free cash flow this calendar year.
We now expect 12% full year revenue growth, including approximately 4 percentage points for fuel price-driven surcharge revenue.
We continue to expect $3.9 billion of CapEx for CY '26, of which 90% is maintenance or efficiency related.

guidance.value: nearly $1 billion by end CY26; $2 billion cumulative by end CY27
guidance.quote: We continue to expect Network 2.0 progress to translate to nearly $1 billion of Network 2.0 and associated One FedEx savings by the end of this calendar year
we are on track to achieve our target of $650 million Europe-driven improvement in International adjusted operating income by end of 2029.

guidance.metric: US Domestic adjusted operating margin CY27
guidance.quote: we forecast full year adjusted U.S. Domestic operating margin to be up year-over-year.
we expect our CY '26 effective tax rate to be approximately 22.5%, down 50 basis points from our prior assumption.

prior_guidance_check.quote: we are raising and tightening our CY '26 outlook to $18 to $18.60.

red_flags.label: Q4 cost headwinds stack up; margin pressure
red_flags.quote: we anticipate several transitory headwinds that will pressure our results

evasions.topic: Timing of International margin step-up in CY27
evasions.quote: I'm not going to give you the timing for CY '27, but look forward to discussing that with you on our Q4 call.
I'm going to let Claude just weigh in on freight monetization and other things
